title: Defective-do not buy
text:
Defective-do not buy. The Auto-shut off does not work.
DO NOT BUY!! I didnt realize the 1st one i bought did the same thing. 2 seperate units, 9 months apart and neither auto-shut off works. Unsafe!!

product_metadata.title: Sunnydaze Portable Ceramic Electric Space Heater - Indoor Use for Home and Office - Small Personal Heating Appliance with Auto Shut-Off Safety Feature - 1500W/750W
features: Warms up cool spaces: This portable heater for a room measures 6.5 inches diameter x 5.5 inches deep x 8.5 inches tall; Base of heater is 5.5 inches deep and 5 inches wide; Weighs 3.2 pounds; 6-foot long power cord; 1500 watts; 15 amps; 120 volts; 5120 BTUs per hour; Heating area of 15 square meters or 160 square feet

Powerful little heater: Constructed with PTC ceramic heating element to provide constant heat; Features 2 different heat settings: low heat (750W) and high heat (1500W); Power indicator light shows when heater is turned on; Heater surface stays cool after prolonged use

Perfect for home: Space heater quickly warms ups with very little noise; Quiet operation makes it handy to keep at your desk when your office gets chilly; Also great for keeping the living room and bedroom cozy warm in your home; For indoor use only

Great for winter: Heater boasts features to keep you safely warm; Equipped with an internal heat-limiting thermostat and overheat protection circuit; When a potential overheat temperature is reached, the system will automatically shut the heater off; Features 2-prong polarized plug
Worry-free purchasing: Sunnydaze Decor backs its products with a 1-year manufacturer's warranty
